Upstream repository build terms retained verbatim for provenance; SVG-specific headers govern the copied artwork.

notes: JetBrains SVGs and upstream license/notice are copied without modification from the pinned commit.
Dark themes prefer upstream _dark.svg; files with no upstream dark variant use the upstream shared variant.
Go, neutral code fallback, and expanded folder SVGs are original geometric artwork, not proprietary GoLand/Go icons.
Classic themes use their own community file-type artwork; absent categories use a documented classic neutral fallback rather than New UI artwork.
Maps are per-file and per-extension only; Orca does not support folder-name mappings in this contract.
